feeds.title: Equip Blog
feeds.description: Equip is a ministry of the Billy Graham Center at Wheaton College, founded in 1980 with a mission to equip Christians for ministry. The Equip blog features articles and resources for Christian leaders and practitioners, covering topics such as church planting, evangelism, and discipleship.

feeds.title: Red Letter Christians » LGBTQ+ Blog
feeds.description: Red Letter Christians is a movement founded by Tony Campolo and Shane Claiborne with the aim of living out the teachings of Jesus in a radical and inclusive way. Their blog on LGBTQ+ issues explores how Christians can support and affirm the LGBTQ+ community, challenging traditional views on gender and sexuality.

feeds.title: A Spiral Dance
feeds.description: This blog is written by Lee Hicks, a queer theologian and spiritual director, who seeks to explore the intersections of faith, sexuality, and gender. Through personal reflections, creative writing, and critical analysis, Lee invites readers to join in the dance of the divine mystery.

feeds.title: Open Table Network Blog
feeds.description: Open Table Network is a community of progressive Christians who are committed to social justice, inclusion, and equality. The organization aims to create a safe and welcoming space for everyone, regardless of their background or beliefs. The blog provides a platform for writers to share their thoughts on a variety of topics related to faith, including theology, spirituality, and social justice.

feeds.title: Whosoever
feeds.description: Whosoever is an online magazine that provides resources and support for the LGBTQ+ Christian community. The magazine aims to promote acceptance and understanding of LGBTQ+ individuals within the Christian faith. The blog provides a platform for writers to share their experiences and perspectives on a variety of topics related to faith and the LGBTQ+ community.

feeds.title: Impact Magazine
feeds.description: Impact Magazine is a publication that focuses on the intersection of faith and social justice. The magazine aims to provide a platform for writers to share their perspectives and insights on issues related to faith and social justice. The blog provides a space for writers to share their thoughts on a variety of topics, including racism, poverty, and environmental justice.

feeds.description: Independent Christian News

feeds.title: QSpirit Blog
feeds.description: Q Spirit presents LGBTQ spirituality through the Jesus in Love Blog. Saints, history, books, art and more are covered in articles by Kittredge Cherry. Q Spirit promotes LGBTQ spirituality with saints, history, art and books. The website fosters religious and artistic freedom by teaching love for all people, regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity. It expands the meaning of holiness for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and questioning (LGBTQ) people of faith and allies.

feeds.title: Q Christian Blog
feeds.description: The Q Christian Fellowship Blog shares ideas, resources, guest contributions, and announcements. The Q Christian Fellowship is a a diverse community with varied backgrounds, cultures, theologies, and denominations, drawn together through the love of Christ and our belief that every person is a beloved child of God.

feeds.title: The Christian Closet Blog
feeds.description: This blog was founded by Dr. Candice Czubernat, a licensed clinical psychologist and ordained minister, to provide a safe and supportive space for LGBTQ+ individuals of faith. Through her blog, Dr. Czubernat shares resources and insights to help LGBTQ+ people navigate the intersections of their identities and faith.

feeds.title: Strength In Weakness Blog
feeds.description: This ministry was founded in 1980 with a mission to provide education, resources, and support to those who experience same-sex attraction and desire to follow Jesus Christ. Their blog features personal stories, biblical reflections, and practical guidance for those navigating the complexities of faith and sexuality.

feeds.title: Love & Culture
feeds.description: This blog is written by Brandan Robertson, a theologian, pastor, and LGBTQ+ activist, who seeks to explore how the Christian faith can foster love and justice in our cultural moment. Through his writing, Brandan invites readers to engage with contemporary issues and reimagine Christianity as a force for good in the world.

feeds.title: OtherWise Christian Blog
feeds.description: OtherWise Christian is an organization dedicated to promoting the inclusion of transgender and gender-nonconforming individuals in the Christian faith. The organization aims to create a space where everyone can feel welcome and supported, regardless of their gender identity or expression. The blog provides a platform for writers to share their experiences and perspectives on a variety of topics related to faith and gender identity.
